$comment: SCVS local schema revision based on stellar-protocol PR #1944. The upstream draft predates SEP-58 v0.6.0; this local schema keeps schema_version 1.0 while incorporating TRD section 5.2's current wire fields. It is not byte-for-byte identical to the upstream draft.
title: Contract Verification Status Object (SCVS TRD 5.2)
description: The static status document at <result-root>/wasms/{wasm_hash}.json. The dynamic /api/{service}/v1/wasms/{wasm_hash}.json routes are separate deployment surfaces and may be absent.

schema_version.description: The version of the response schema, as MAJOR.MINOR, versioned independently of the SEP. MAJOR increments on a breaking change; MINOR on an additive change. This schema describes version 1.0.

wasm_hash.description: The queried wasm hash, echoed back. Lowercase hex SHA-256.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this record was last updated across all of its verifications. Always present.

source_code_verifications.description: One or more rebuild-from-source verification results, each from one verifier.

verifier.description: Identity of the verifier that produced (or is producing) this result.

name.description: A human-readable name for the verifier.

url.description: A URL identifying the verifier or describing its methodology.

logo_url.description: A logo for the verifier. Either a URL string, or an object with light and/or dark URL variants for light and dark backgrounds. The image SHOULD be square; a transparent background is recommended.

out_of_band.description: When true, this verification was established outside SEP-58's reproducible-build mechanisms (e.g. a custom or non-allowlisted build image, or private source). Absent or false means a standard reproducible SEP-58 verification.

bldimg.description: SEP-58 bldimg. Fully-qualified container image pinned by digest.

bldarg.description: SEP-58 v0.6.0 bldarg. Leading contract entry-point arguments; order is significant. An absent value means the default contract build entry point.

bldopt.description: SEP-58 bldopt. One entry per build flag; order is not significant.

source_sha256.description: SEP-58 v0.6.0 source_sha256. SHA-256 of the source archive bytes used for verification.

source_uri.description: SEP-58 v0.6.0 source_uri. The source archive location observed at verification time.

verified_source_code_uri.description: TRD section 5.2 verified_source_code_uri. A public URI for the retained source bytes that produced this verification, when the source is public.

source_repo.description: Legacy Registry draft source_repo. Superseded by SEP-58 v0.6.0 source_uri; retained so historical draft 1.0 documents remain describable.

source_rev.description: Legacy Registry draft source_rev. Superseded by the current SEP-58 source vocabulary; retained for historical draft 1.0 documents.

tarball_url.description: Legacy Registry draft tarball_url. Superseded by SEP-58 v0.6.0 source_uri; retained for historical draft 1.0 documents.

tarball_sha256.description: Legacy Registry draft tarball_sha256. Superseded by SEP-58 v0.6.0 source_sha256; retained for historical draft 1.0 documents.

rebuilt_hash.description: The conflicting lowercase hex SHA-256 the verifier produced by rebuilding from source. Present only when status is mismatched; omitted for verified (where it would equal wasm_hash) and unverified.

processed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this verification was processed. Required for verified and mismatched; must be omitted for unverified.

results_urls.description: Zero or more open-scheme URIs to an externally-published record of this verification. Plain strings, as Registry API draft 1.0 defines them: no entry carries a type or a hash. The structured {type, url, sha256?} form is FT1 (IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC section C.1) and is not part of 1.0; IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC AU1 records the withdrawal, and a report URI keeps its integrity anchor in the reports/<sha256>.json filename.

allOf.$comment: rebuilt_hash is the conflicting hash, so it is required for mismatched and absent otherwise.
verified and mismatched are processed results, so processed_at is required.
unverified is not a processed result, so processed_at must be absent.
